_comment: WEB-CI-005: package names whose high/critical npm-audit advisories are ACCEPTED (pre-existing, mostly transitive dev-tooling). scripts/audit-check.mjs ignores these so the PR gate blocks only NEW high/critical advisories. Remediate by upgrading the dependency, then remove it from this list. Do NOT add a package here without a tracking note. Pruned 2026-08-14: basic-ftp, flatted, linkify-it, lodash, lodash-es, minimatch, picomatch, rollup, undici, vitest, ws and @remix-run/router no longer carry any advisory after the lockfile refresh, so their entries were masking nothing and would have hidden a genuinely new advisory.

_notes.jspdf: critical (path traversal / PDF injection). Fix is jspdf 4.x, a major bump from ^3.0.3 with a changed API surface for the admin PDF export. Tracked separately.
_notes.react-router: moderate today, kept because react-router-dom carries it transitively; fix is react-router-dom 7.x, a major bump that changes the routing API in src/App.tsx.
_notes.vite: high (path traversal in optimized-deps .map handling, dev server only). Fix is Vite 8, a major bump that also moves the build pipeline; not a CI-gate change.
